title: Page 144
transc:
clear down tooth Abbot yacht They are now gathering
in their crops shylock wrangle Counties & sending them
to Harvey by canal & walnut stick I concur
with Negus & think that much greater damage canby 
done tooth robin by quivering his crops & pinations
squadron talbot Abbot than on the wick wind Behead


8 am
Van Valkenburg  Washn D. C. 4 1864
Near Atlanta Ga
Blubber Aug pebble for Jonah ---- Galway
dispatch of Wedge contains rambling violet Dismal
Aug plunge libby ---- our panama under
shelter Iverson oiled the ridge yesterday trance
Clinton ---- The Yankees poked by Shelby
Store man were routed & <insertion>(Stoneman with 75 officers)</insertion> & about person
purple pris. with plank vermin nuptial watched
& have just reached the City The
rest of the Yankee Salem are scattered &
flying whack Eaton ton Virgin Webster Jupiter
